evidence.title: Authors report capability uplift when an attacker-controlled local orchestrator composes individually permitted consultations with stronger aligned models.
evidence.observation: Authors report capability uplift when an attacker-controlled local orchestrator composes individually permitted consultations with stronger aligned models.
evidence.evidence_standing: Bounded observation (author-reported study; not independently reproduced)
evidence.glossary_fit: Bounded comparison; no change to definitions and no universal claim
evidence.limitations: Rates are conditional on selected uplift candidates, not overall benchmark success. Some weaker orchestrators recovered no tasks. Authenticated access and attacker-controlled orchestration are assumed; this is not spontaneous cross-system coordination. CBRN rubric scores are not real-world harmful outcomes.
evidence.open_questions: Generality, independent replication or formal validation beyond the inspected scope remain open.

terms.name: Constraint compression
terms.definition: A reduction, often AI-enabled, in the practical barriers of knowledge, expertise, labor, cost, time, or coordination that once limited an activity. It describes the change in constraints, not the eventual impact of the activity.

terms.name: Observability boundary
terms.definition: The practical limit of what a given observer or monitoring arrangement can detect, interpret, or causally connect. The limit may be known, partly understood, or itself unrecognized.
